name: JW Marriott St. Maarten Beach Resort & Spa
insider_take: Where Dutch sophistication meets Caribbean soul on the pristine shores of St. Maarten's most coveted coastline.
whats_special: This luxury resort sits on the famous Maho Beach area, where you can witness the thrilling spectacle of planes landing just overhead at Princess Juliana International Airport. The property features the island's largest spa and boasts direct access to one of St. Maarten's most beautiful white sand beaches. As part of Marriott's exclusive Luminous Program, guests enjoy elevated luxury experiences with personalized service.
pro_tip: Book a beachfront suite for the ultimate plane-spotting experience – the low-flying aircraft create an unforgettable spectacle that's become a bucket-list attraction for travelers worldwide.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Quantus Spa, one of the Caribbean's most luxurious wellness destinations, and sunset cocktails at the beachfront bar while watching the daily aviation show. Take advantage of the duty-free shopping just minutes away in Philipsburg, and explore both the Dutch and French sides of this unique dual-nation island.
pros: Pristine beachfront location on Dawn Beach with crystal-clear waters
Luxurious full-service spa offering Caribbean-inspired treatments
Multiple dining venues featuring international and local Caribbean cuisine
Premium JW Marriott service standards with personalized guest experiences
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Hurricane season may affect travel plans June through November
